predictions.rationale: Centralized event handling and message pumping are likely to include logging mechanisms for debug and trace purposes.
Undo management often involves logging changes to track state transitions and debug issues.
Main application entry points typically initialize logging frameworks and handle global debug configurations.
Resource loading often involves logging to debug missing or misconfigured resources.
Persistence management frequently includes logging to track file operations and errors.
Heap monitoring tools often include logging to track memory usage and identify potential issues.
Exception handling dialogs are likely to log errors and stack traces for debugging purposes.
Project management interfaces often log user actions and state changes for debugging and traceability.
Configuration handlers typically log changes and errors to help debug configuration issues.
Parsing components often log errors and warnings to assist in debugging malformed input.
